premises: Nanoscale coherent precipitates impede crack propagation by blocking dislocations and crack nucleation.
Coarsened precipitates act as stress concentrators that promote crack initiation.
A fine, homogeneous dispersion of precipitates yields higher fracture toughness than a coarsened dispersion.
The effect is testable in FCC or BCC HEAs heat-treated between ~300°C and 800°C.
